text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Big Bro. Wake up! Hey!
...Hey, Big Sis. Wake up! Hey!

Overwhelmingly tired, I open my eyes.
Blinded by
the light, I make out a girl
dressed in black and
white. She's
smiling, and I feel myself strangely

drawn to her.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I can be whichever one you
want. ♪ But for
now...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I'll be whichever one you want. ♪
But for
now...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Curren Chan Chop!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
There! You're finally awake. Morning,

sleepyhead! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
There! You're finally awake. Morning,

sleepyhead! ♪

Her whack brings me back to reality. I
guess I
nodded off.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Don't you remember?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Don't you remember?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
This is my signature racewear! We made
it
together!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Well, you did pass out the second we
finished, so
I'm not surprised you forgot.
You sure were tired.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Well, you did pass out the second we
finished, so
I'm not surprised you forgot.
You sure were tired.

What in the world happened to me?
Come to
think of it, Curren Chan and I
were looking at
some samples for her
signature racewear a few
days ago...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...It's not enough.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no, the racewear itself is wonderful.
I can tell
the person who made it really
poured their heart
into making it the
way I wanted.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
But... it's still not enough. My signature
racewear
needs an extra oomph of
cuteness.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Now the rest is up to me... and you, of
course!
We've got work to do!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So actually... I've got a favor to ask. Do
you
mind?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So actually... I've got a favor to ask. Do
you
mind?

That's right! I remember now! Curren
Chan asked
for something insane after
that, and I had no
choice but to accept.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That fabric is made from pearls. I heard
there's a
type of pearl in a certain ocean
that can be used
to create fabric that
shines beautifully if crushed
and mixed.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That said, it's not a very noticeable
shine. It's
more of a "if you know, you
know" type of thing.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
But just imagine it. A mystical light
emitting from
me while I run... Think of
the impression that'd
leave!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It's perfect, just what I need! Come look
for it
with me! Pleeeaaase!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It's perfect, just what I need! Come look
for it
with me! Pleeeaaase!

And so, we go to an unexplored patch
of ocean...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I heard you can only get it if you free
dive. Can I
even do it? I dunno, it's kinda
scary...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Really?! You're the best! ♪ I'll stay here
and be
the best cheerleader ever!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Go, Big Bro! Go, Big Bro! Go! ♪ Fight
on! Fight
on! Over there! You can do
it! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Go, Big Sis! Go, Big Sis! Go! ♪ Fight on!
Fight on!
Over there! You can do it! ♪

I dive again countless times, completely

exhausting myself. Finally, I manage to
find the
pearl Curren Chan wants.
I remember everything now! That's how we finished Curren Chan's signature racewear!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It's all because of your hard work that
my
signature racewear turned out so
good. Thank
you. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It's all because of your hard work that
my
signature racewear turned out so
good. Thank
you. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Sooo... Whaddya think? Do I look cute?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Sooo... Whaddya think? Do I look cute?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. Yay! I absolutely love it.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure I win a bunch wearing
this. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure I win a bunch wearing
this. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I want the color of my signature
racewear to be
perfect. Not just any old
dye will do.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I heard there's a flower deep in the
mountains
that's been around for a
thousand years.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
They say that if you use it to dye fabric,
it'll turn
into a color that captivates
anyone who lays eyes
on it.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
But apparently, you have to go past a
bunch of
booby traps to get to it...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It could be a dangerous trip. But... I
need that
flower no matter what! Will
you come with me?
Pleeease!

I can certainly see her resolve and
passion...
However, I can't just bring her
somewhere
dangerous. What I should do
is...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Seriously?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Th-thanks, but... are you sure you'll be
okay by
yourself?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Okay... I'll be waiting, so don't take too
long. I
believe in you!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Okay... I'll be waiting, so don't take too
long. I
believe in you!

And so, I hike deep into the unexplored

mountains, avoiding so many deadly
traps that I
lose count...

I remember everything now! That's how
we
finished Curren Chan's signature
racewear!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So, whaddya think? Do I look...
captivating?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So, whaddya think? Do I look...
captivating?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, good. It's because you work so
hard for
me that I can achieve my dream.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, good. It's because you work so
hard for
me that I can achieve my dream.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'll captivate everyone even more with
this outfit
and never let them go. So, Big
Bro...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'll captivate everyone even more with
this outfit
and never let them go. So, Big
Sis...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Just keep me in your heart, okay? ♪
